title: Plasma-Light Hybrid Computer (Signature) — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Mirrors its public twin record: One computer, two substrates: plasma and light coupled into a single machine. The Signature extension defines the hybrid instruction set: opcodes that begin in plasma and finish in light, compiled as one program. This is a Signature-concept extension (speculative): it is an original design proposal for the JAH system, never presented as established physics.
capabilities: Couple plasma wave outputs directly to optical modulators
Route workloads to plasma, photonic, or joint execution
